welcome.title: One place to organize your team's support.
welcome.description: NexoDesk is being developed to bring customers, teams and support requests together in one place.
welcome.development_notice: Work in progress. Company and ticket management features will be available later.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Organize each company with its own team and data.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Keep your company's customer details and contact information together.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Track support requests, set priorities and assign team members.

login.title: Log in to your account
login.description: Enter your email and password to continue.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Enter your details to create your account.

forgot_password.title: Forgot password
forgot_password.description: Enter your email to receive a password reset link.

reset_password.title: Reset password
reset_password.description: Enter and confirm your new password.

confirm.title: Confirm password
confirm.description: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.authentication_description: Enter the code provided by your authenticator application.
two_factor.recovery_description: Confirm access to your account by entering one of your emergency recovery codes.

verify_email.title: Email verification
verify_email.description: Please verify your email address by clicking the link we emailed to you.
verify_email.sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.

profile.title: Profile settings
profile.heading: Profile
profile.description: Update your name and email address.
profile.verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.

settings.description: Manage your profile and account settings.

security.label: Security
security.title: Security settings
security.password_description: Use a long, unique password to protect your account.

delete_account.title: Delete account
delete_account.description: Delete your account and all of its resources.
delete_account.warning_description: Please proceed with caution. This cannot be undone.
delete_account.confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
delete_account.confirm_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will also be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.

two_factor.disabled_description: When you enable two-factor authentication, you will be prompted for a code during login. You can retrieve this code from a TOTP-compatible authenticator app on your phone.
two_factor.enabled_description: During login, you will be prompted for a code from the authenticator app you configured on your phone.

setup.title: Enable two-factor authentication
setup.description: To finish enabling two-factor authentication, scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.
setup.enabled_description: Two-factor authentication is now enabled. Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.
setup.verify_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Recovery codes let you regain access if you lose your authentication device. Store them in a secure password manager.
recovery.usage: Each recovery code can only be used once and is removed after use. To get new codes, use the regenerate codes button above.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Manage your passkeys for passwordless sign-in.
passkeys.empty_description: Add a passkey to sign in without a password.
passkeys.unsupported: Passkeys are not supported in this browser.
passkeys.name: Passkey name
passkeys.name_help: Choose a name that helps you identify this passkey later.
passkeys.remove_description: Are you sure you want to remove the passkey “{name}”? You will no longer be able to use it to sign in.

two_factor.qr_code: Failed to fetch the QR code.
two_factor.setup_key: Failed to fetch the setup key.
